about_the_game:
Important:

• This is a special DLC for Publisher Weekend 2025 that will be available until March 31.
• If you already have the Excelsior, you will receive 500,000 credits as compensation.

This bundle includes:

• Excelsior Premium tank (U.K., heavy, Tier V)
• Garage slot
• 9 equipment slots
• Ice Block Rare camouflage
• 20 Epic Combat XP boosters
• 20 Epic Crew XP boosters
• 20 Epic Credits boosters

The Excelsior is a heavy tank with an effective, quick-firing gun and dynamic acceleration. It also has a well-protected front and rear, plus side screens. Even when surrounded, this mighty heavy won't give up that easily, making sure no enemy escapes without a shell to their side!

This DLC can only be added to your World of Tanks Blitz account once.
